title: Hook Rule
description: Schema for Claude Code hook rules. Each rule defines when and how to intercept a hook event.

Action.description: What to do when the rule matches.

x-descriptions.deny: Block the operation, return reason to Claude
x-descriptions.ask: Ask user for confirmation before proceeding
x-descriptions.transform: Modify the tool input before execution
x-descriptions.stderr: Write reason to stderr (visible to user, not Claude)
x-descriptions.load: Load file contents into additionalContext (requires loaders field)

Draft07Schema.description: Draft-07 JSON Schema used as match condition. ObjectTree(data, schema) succeeds = match.

UnbashCommand.description: unbash Command node. match_bash schemas match against this structure.

x-match-patterns.arg-contains: suffix: { type: 'array', contains: { properties: { text: { const: 'X' } } } }
x-match-patterns.redirect-out: redirects: { type: 'array', contains: { properties: { operator: { enum: ['>','>>'] } } } }
x-match-patterns.required-cmd: required: ['name']  (top-level only, never inside property sub-schema)

ToolMatcher.description: Quick filter by tool name. Applied before match/match_bash.

name.description: Unique rule identifier. Used as filename: {name}.json

description.description: Human-readable description of what this rule does.

enabled.description: true = active, false = disabled, 'test' = match + log but no action (dry-run).

priority.description: Execution order. Lower = runs first. 0-20: allow/fast-path, 30-60: normal, 70-100: catch-all.

cwd.description: Project filter by cwd. Matches if event.cwd contains any of the given strings (project name or path fragment). Rules without cwd apply globally.

match.description: Draft-07 schema to validate against event object. ObjectTree(event, match) succeeds = match.

match_bash.description: Draft-07 schema matched against unbash Command nodes. See UnbashCommand definition for structure. required: [...] goes at top level only — never inside nested property sub-schemas.

reason.description: Message shown to Claude when rule triggers (deny/ask). Supports markdown.

config.description: Feature-specific configuration passed to the feature function.

feature.description: Feature module to invoke when action is 'context' or 'transform'. Use string for no-config features, object for features requiring configuration.

transform.description: Transformation spec when action is 'transform'. Feature-specific.

updatedInput.description: Static transform config: {field, pattern, replace}. Applied when action is 'transform'.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match. Validated at load time.

loaders.description: File loaders for 'load' action. Each loads a file into additionalContext.

path.description: File path (supports ~). Must be under home, /var/log, or relative.

tags.description: Tags for grouping and filtering rules.

agent.description: Agent configuration: spawn subagent to handle the event. Agent receives event context and can use specified tools.

prompt.description: System prompt / instructions for the agent

repeat.description: true = fire every time (default). false = once per session. integer = cooldown seconds.

deny-rm.name: deny-rm
deny-rm.description: Block rm command, suggest mv to .cleanup/ or .backup/
deny-rm.reason: rm is disabled. Use: mv file .cleanup/

redirect-websearch.name: redirect-websearch
redirect-websearch.description: Redirect WebSearch to MCP search tools
